description:
Archie Living
Archie, a vibrant & dynamic nest in the heart of Barcelona
Mid - Stay apartments to feel at home, starting from 32 days to 11 months

Welcome to Archie Living
At Archie Living, we specialize in providing stylish and comfortable mid-stay apartments designed to make you feel right at home. Our apartments offer the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and modern amenities.
As a professional operator and large-scale housing provider (gran tenedor) under current regulations, we ensure full compliance while maintaining a consistent and high-quality guest experience across all our apartments.
Our commitment to quality and attention to detail is evident in every aspect of our properties. Each apartment is thoughtfully furnished and equipped with everything you need for a seamless stay, including fully equipped kitchens, cozy living spaces, and high-speed internet.
Explore our available apartments and discover why so many choose Archie Living for their mid-stay accommodation needs. Welcome to a new standard of living – welcome to Archie Living.

STAY & LIVE
A new kind of apartment for a new way of living.
A flexible home-office hybrid designed for modern living. Thoughtfully crafted to make the most of every square meter, each apartment blends the comfort of home with the functionality of a workspace. It’s not just a place to stay — it’s your base for living, working, and creating, all under one roof. Spacious, intelligent, and effortlessly adaptable, Archie sets a new standard in contemporary urban living.

WORK & Connect
Quiet focus, creative energy, and everything you need to work your way.
Our Mezzanine is more than just a co-working space, it’s a thoughtfully designed area for productivity, collaboration, and inspiration. Whether you’re co-working alongside a diverse community or leading a team session, you’ll find the setup you need: a screen and projector for presentations, power outlets at every table, a cozy reading nook, and complimentary coffee and water to keep your ideas flowing. Settle in, plug in, and make it a workday that works for you.

EAT & DRINK
Discover Local Flavors with Archie Living
Enjoy on-site and nearby dining options including Starbucks for your coffee fix, Gatopardo Restaurante Italiano for authentic Italian cuisine, and Honest Greens for fresh, organic meals. Additionally, our rooftop terrace is available for organizing personalized dining experiences or events to suit your preferences.

COMMUNITY & EVENTS
Because amazing things happen when people come together.
We created Archie, The Living Club to make space for a community that thrives on curiosity, creativity, and shared experiences. Our events- designed in collaboration with local partners, artists, and entrepreneurs – are an open invitation to connect, exchange ideas, and grow together. Whether it’s a rooftop gathering, a workshop, or a casual talk, every moment is a chance to expand your circle and your perspective. Come see what it means to be part of a living, breathing community.

A central location with a local feel
Archie Living is located at Avenida Vilanova 9, right between the charming Born district and the elegant Eixample neighborhood. Just a short walk from Plaça Catalunya, Ciutadella Park, and the Arc de Triomf, you’ll enjoy the perfect mix of city energy and green space.
Plus, the beach is only 15 minutes away on foot. It’s the ideal location for those who want to live in the heart of Barcelona while enjoying the calm vibe of a well-connected residential area. Nearby metro, train, and bus lines make it easy to get around the entire city.
Official address print: C/ Av. de Vilanova, 9, L'Eixample, 08018 Barcelona, Spain.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION
To confirm your booking, we need your full residential address. We only accept bookings for personal stays (leisure, holiday, or recreational) once your details are verified.

Official apartments hub
INTRODUCING THE ARCHIE APARTMENTS
Welcome to Archie Mid-Stay Apartments, offering stylish one, two, and three-bedroom units designed for mid-stay comfort. Enjoy luxurious amenities, including a rooftop terrace and swimming pool.
Located at the iconic Arc de Triomf in Barcelona, our apartments provide easy access to local attractions and public transport. Flexible lease terms and all-inclusive pricing make your stay hassle-free. Experience exceptional service and a seamless living experience with Archie Mid-Stay Apartments.
STAY & LIVE: Rest, work, eat, and repeat-all within the comfort of your personal Archie Apartment.
At Archie Living, we understand that life doesn’t always fit into a neat schedule. That’s why our mid-stay apartments are designed to offer you the flexibility and comfort you need.
Why Archie Apartments?
Prime Location — Located near the iconic Arc de Triomf in Barcelona, our apartments offer easy access to the city’s top attractions, dining, and public transport, placing you in the heart of the action.
Luxurious Amenities — Enjoy top-notch facilities including a rooftop terrace with stunning views and a refreshing swimming pool, designed to enhance your living experience.
Flexible Living Options — With our one, two, and three-bedroom units and flexible lease terms, you can find the perfect accommodation to suit your needs.
Exceptional Service — Our dedicated team is committed to providing outstanding service, ensuring your stay is seamless, comfortable, and stress-free from start to finish.

Shared type-page THE FULL LOWDOWN (printed on each live KEEP card)
Technology — At Archie Living, we ensure our residents are connected and entertained with state-of-the-art technology. Each apartment is equipped with high-speed WiFi, smart TVs, and modern entertainment systems.
Bathroom — Our bathrooms are designed with luxury and functionality in mind. They feature modern fixtures, spacious showers or bathtubs, premium toiletries, and ample storage to provide a spa-like experience.
Kitchen Utensils — The kitchens at Archie Living are fully equipped with high-quality utensils and appliances. From pots and pans to cutlery and cooking gadgets, everything you need to prepare meals is readily available. Modern kitchen appliances include microwaves, dishwashers, ceramic cooktops, ovens, and washers and dryers. Additionally, each kitchen comes with a toaster, Nespresso coffee maker, juicer, and blender for your convenience.
Workstation — For those who work from home, we offer dedicated workstations within the apartments. These spaces are designed to be comfortable and productive, featuring ergonomic chairs, spacious desks, and ample lighting. High-speed internet and plenty of power outlets ensure you stay connected and efficient.
Elevated Private Bedroom Area — Providing a unique and cozy sleeping space that maximizes the use of vertical space. These areas are designed with comfort in mind, offering comfortable mattresses and stylish bedding.
Living Room Area — Our living room areas are spacious and inviting, perfect for relaxation and socializing. They are furnished with comfortable seating, stylish decor, and entertainment options such as smart TVs and Marshall sound systems. Large windows allow plenty of natural light, creating a warm and welcoming environment.
Services & Facilities — Archie Living provides a range of services and facilities to enhance your living experience. These include a concierge service, housekeeping, laundry facilities with washers and dryers, a fitness center, and a coworking area. Our rooftop pool offers a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the views, while our communal areas and gardens provide space for socializing and events. Additionally, we offer secure parking and easy access to public transportation. The rooftop also features an outdoor cinema area, perfect for movie nights under the stars, as well as a barbecue area. Elevators are available for easy access to all floors, and a cleaning kit is provided upon arrival.
Terraces — All our apartments feature private terraces of 8 square meters, offering an ideal space for outdoor relaxation, dining, or enjoying the views of the surrounding area. Penthouses print a 50 m² terrace on the type card (not the shared 8 m² line as the penthouse terrace size).

With regular community events, workshops, and informal networking moments, you’ll have natural opportunities to connect with like-minded people during your stay.

Official about
Welcome to Archie, A place designed to live and inspire connections and community.
This building, made up of 102 apartments, offers an ideal option for those looking for a place to stay for an extended stay. These mid-stay apartments are designed to provide comfort and functionality.
Each apartment has been carefully equipped with modern and elegant furniture, guaranteeing a cozy and sophisticated atmosphere. In addition, the facilities include essential and additional services, such as high-speed internet connection, regular housekeeping and customer service available 24 hours a day.
The location of the building is unbeatable: we are located in the emblematic Arc de Triomphe, just two steps from the vibrant Born neighborhood and just 15 minutes from Barcelona beach.
Development by Conren Tramway
Our apartments represent an optimal solution for those looking for the perfect combination of comfort, functionality and style.

Official FAQs
1. What is Archie Living? Archie Living offers stylish and comfortable mid-stay apartments located near the iconic Arc de Triomf in Barcelona. Our apartments are designed for those needing temporary residence, whether for business, relocation, or an extended vacation.
2. What types of apartments are available? We provide a range of fully furnished one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as luxurious penthouses. Each unit is equipped with modern amenities to ensure a comfortable and convenient stay.
3. What amenities do Archie Apartments offer? Our apartments include access to luxurious amenities such as a rooftop terrace with stunning views, a refreshing swimming pool, high-speed internet, and more. Each apartment also comes with a fully equipped kitchen, an iron and ironing board, and a private terrace of at least 8 m². For those working remotely, every apartment features a dedicated workspace with a desk and chair.
4. What views do the apartments offer? Our Deluxe apartments offer stunning views of the front area, facing the iconic Arc de Triomf. The other apartments face the rear, offering a view of a large inner courtyard typical of the Eixample district, providing a peaceful and charming atmosphere.
5. What is included in the rental price? The rental price includes access to our common areas, weekly cleaning with a change of sheets and towels, utilities, and Wi-Fi.
6. How can I book an apartment? You can book an apartment directly through our website. Simply select your desired dates, choose the apartment that suits your needs, and complete the booking process. A valid credit card is required to secure your reservation.
7. What information is mandatory to confirm my reservation? To confirm your reservation, it is mandatory to provide the full address of your usual residence. At Archie Living, we only accept reservations for recreational, tourist, holiday, or leisure stays.
8. What is the check-in and check-out process? Check-in details will be provided upon booking confirmation. Generally, check-in is from 3 PM and check-out is by 11 AM. The access codes for your apartment will be sent 24 hours before your arrival, once you have completed the online check-in process.
9. What is the cancellation policy? Cancellations made up to 14 days before the check-in date will receive a full refund. Cancellations made within 14 days of the check-in date will incur a fee equivalent to one night’s stay. No-shows will be charged the full amount of the reservation.
10. Are pets allowed? Yes, we welcome dogs at Archie Apartments. Please inform us in advance if you plan to bring your pet, as additional cleaning fees may apply.
11. Is there a minimum stay requirement? Yes, the minimum stay requirement is 32 days and the maximum stay is 11 months.
12. Is parking available? Parking is available but is not included in the apartment rental. The cost for parking is €350 per month. Please contact us in advance to arrange parking.
13. How do I contact Archie Living for further assistance? You can reach us via email at hola@archieliving.com or by phone at +34679443832.
14. Can I extend my stay? Yes, if you wish to extend your stay, please contact us as soon as possible. Extensions are subject to availability and may require an additional booking process. Please note that the minimum stay is 32 days and the maximum is 11 months.

Official sustainability
Located in an area rich with buildings from Barcelona’s industrial era (late 19th century), Archie Living incorporates iron structures, ceramic, brick, and glass details into its design, seamlessly blending with the local environment. The metallic structure on its façade, characterized by its striking verticality, draws inspiration from landmarks such as the Estació del Nord, symbolizing a harmonious integration with the city’s architectural past and present.
Renewable Energy; Energy Efficiency; Water Management; Sustainable Materials; Ecological Paints and Finishes; Plastic Reduction Initiatives; Green Roofs; Smart Technology; Local Suppliers and Products; Breeam ©.

Official FAQs
General
What is CALM APARTMENTS? CALM APARTMENTS offers fully equipped apartments in Barcelona for temporary stays of medium and long duration, always exceeding 32 days, combining the comfort of a home with personalised services and attention.
What type of stay does CALM APARTMENTS offer? Our apartments specialise in temporary stays from 32 nights onwards, ideal for those who wish to enjoy Barcelona with comfort, flexibility and peace of mind.
What type of guest is CALM APARTMENTS ideal for? CALM APARTMENTS is ideal for: couples, families, executives and relocated professionals, expatriates, digital nomads, temporary residents, medical patients and companions.
Who usually stays for a month or more? Many of our guests are international professionals, families in transition, people undergoing medical treatments or travellers who need a comfortable and flexible stay in Barcelona.
Is CALM APARTMENTS a good option for job relocations or expatriates? Yes. Many professionals and expatriates choose CALM APARTMENTS while settling in Barcelona or searching for their permanent home, thanks to the comfort, location and flexibility of our stays.
Advantages of staying at CALM APARTMENTS
What is the difference between staying at CALM APARTMENTS and a hotel? CALM APARTMENTS offers a more comfortable and private experience than a traditional hotel, with spacious apartments, a fully equipped kitchen, and spaces designed for long stays.
What is the difference between a tourist apartment and a temporary apartment? Our apartments are designed specifically for medium-term temporary stays, offering greater comfort, tranquillity, personalised services and an experience closer to living in Barcelona.
Why choose CALM APARTMENTS for a stay of one month or more? The booking process is quick and straightforward, allowing you to swiftly enjoy a fully equipped apartment ready to make you feel at home from day one.
Remote work and digital nomads
Is CALM APARTMENTS a good option for remote working in Barcelona? Yes. Our apartments offer a quiet and comfortable environment, ideal for working remotely during a temporary stay in Barcelona.
Is the WiFi connection suitable for remote work and video calls? Yes. All apartments have high-speed WiFi, ideal for video calls, online meetings and remote work.
Do the apartments have a comfortable workspace? Yes. The apartments are spacious, bright and functional, allowing you to comfortably combine work and daily life.
Location and surroundings
Where is CALM APARTMENTS located? CALM APARTMENTS is located in a central, quiet and very well connected area of Barcelona.
What important places are nearby? 10 minutes from the Sagrada Família; Less than 15 minutes from Plaça Catalunya; 15 minutes from Passeig de Gràcia; Close to Glòries and La Rambla
What public transport is available nearby? Metro L5 Verdaguer; Bus lines V19, H8, 39, 47, 114, H10, 33 and 34
Can you walk to the main areas of Barcelona? Yes. The location allows you to comfortably walk to many of the main areas of Barcelona.
Is it a quiet area for long stays? Yes. The area combines residential tranquillity with all the services needed to comfortably enjoy a stay in Barcelona.
Do I need a car to get around Barcelona? It is not necessary. The excellent public transport connections and central location make it easy to get around the city.
Are there supermarkets and services nearby? Yes. Just a few minutes' walk away you will find supermarkets, shops, cafés and all kinds of services.
Medical stays
Is CALM APARTMENTS close to clinics and medical centres? Yes. We are close to renowned medical centres in Barcelona such as: Barraquer; IMO; Oftalvist; Turó Park Clinics; ICATME; Quirón; Teknon; Dexeus; Fertilab
Is it a good option for patients and companions? Yes. Many guests choose CALM APARTMENTS during medical treatments thanks to the tranquillity, comfort and good connections to clinics and hospitals.
Why do many patients choose CALM APARTMENTS? Our guests particularly value the peaceful atmosphere, privacy, comfort of the apartments and the ability to feel at home during their recovery or treatment.
Daily life and facilities
Are the apartments fully furnished? Yes. All apartments are fully equipped for a comfortable and functional stay.
What equipment do the apartments include? Depending on the type of apartment, they may include: High-speed WiFi; Television; Washing machine; Dryer; Dishwasher; Microwave; Oven; Fridge and freezer; Fully equipped kitchen
Can you cook daily in the apartment? Yes. The kitchens are fully equipped for comfortable cooking throughout your stay.
Do the apartments have natural light? Yes. The apartments are bright and have good natural ventilation.
Are the apartments comfortable for long stays? Yes. They are designed to provide comfort, functionality and tranquillity during medium and long-term stays.
Services and amenities
What additional amenities does CALM APARTMENTS offer? Our guests can enjoy: Rooftop pool; Private parking; Bicycle and motorcycle storage; Storage rooms and storage spaces
Is cleaning included? Yes. We include weekly cleaning for greater convenience during your stay.
Is WiFi included? Yes. All apartments include high-speed WiFi connection.
Do the apartments have air conditioning and heating? Yes. The apartments are equipped to enjoy a comfortable stay all year round.
How do we ensure a quiet and comfortable environment? CALM APARTMENTS is designed to provide a relaxed, well-maintained and comfortable environment, ideal for resting and enjoying Barcelona with peace of mind.
Bookings and payments
What is the minimum stay? The minimum stay is 32 nights, in accordance with the current temporary rental regulations in Barcelona.
Can the stay be extended? Yes. Subject to availability, we will be happy to help you extend your stay.
How can I make a booking? You can book: directly through our website, by phone, WhatsApp, email, or through our contact form.
What payment methods do you accept? We accept: credit card, bank transfer, PayGold.
What does the apartment price include? The price includes a fully equipped apartment, WiFi, maintenance and weekly cleaning, as well as personalised attention throughout your stay.
Is a deposit required to confirm the booking? Yes. To secure the booking, a deposit is required, the details of which will be provided during the booking process.
What is the cancellation policy? We offer free cancellation up to 15 days before arrival to provide maximum flexibility when planning your stay.
Is a security deposit required? Yes. A refundable deposit of €1,000 is required before arrival to guarantee the excellent condition of the apartments throughout all stays.
Check-in and stay
What time is check-in? The standard check-in time is from 15:00 to 21:00.
Can I request a personalised check-in? Yes. Subject to availability, we will be happy to offer options adapted to your arrival time.
What time must check-out be completed? Check-out must be completed before 12:00 on the day of departure.
What documentation do I need to check in? To formalise the stay you will need to: sign the contract, make the corresponding prepayment, provide the deposit, and present proof of the reason for the temporary stay.
Can the stay be extended once you have checked in? Yes. Subject to availability, we will be able to help you extend your stay comfortably.
The CALM experience
What is it like to live a month at CALM APARTMENTS? Living at CALM APARTMENTS means enjoying Barcelona with the comfort and tranquillity of feeling at home, with fully equipped apartments designed for long stays.
What do our guests value most? Our guests particularly highlight: the tranquillity, the location, the comfort, the cleanliness, the facilities, the rooftop pool, and the personalised attention.
Why do many guests return for another stay? Many guests return to CALM APARTMENTS for the comfort, excellent location and the ease of enjoying a relaxed and flexible stay in Barcelona.
